rule: A block is nothing-assertable only when it carries no passage a reader could quote verbatim from which a source-supported record could be captured, that is, nothing naming a thing, a quantity, a relation, a claim or an attribution; a bibliographic entry is therefore assertable, while a running header, a folio number, figure axis furniture, a legend word list or licence boilerplate is not.
